name: Check Destiny healthcheck
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -u
for host in localhost 127.0.0.1; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 "http://$host:12345/api/health" || true); echo "$host=$code"; done
podman healthcheck run upload-assistant-wastaken >/tmp/healthcheck-result 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "healthcheck_rc=$rc"; cat /tmp/healthcheck-result
podman inspect upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{json .State.Healthcheck}}'
REMOTE
description: Determine why Destiny’s container health remains starting despite the local API responding.
